user.title: Connect REXLiTE
user.description: Download the one-time Home Assistant connection file from the REXLiTE operations platform, then enter the matching values below. Do not use your Home Assistant password or long-lived access token as the agent token.

data_description.agent_id: Use agent_id from the downloaded connection file.
data_description.agent_auth_token: Use agent_auth_token from the downloaded connection file. This is not a Home Assistant access token.
data_description.gateway_ws_url: Use gateway_ws_url from the downloaded connection file.
data_description.home_assistant_url: Use an address reachable from inside Home Assistant. The default works for Container and Core installations.
data_description.remote_admin_enabled: Leave disabled for connection and health monitoring only.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect REXLiTE
reauth_confirm.description: The enrollment credential is no longer accepted. Enter the replacement token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the REXLiTE gateway. Check the network and gateway URL.
error.invalid_auth: The agent ID or authentication token was rejected.
error.invalid_input: One or more values are invalid. Check the URLs and agent ID.

abort.already_configured: This REXLiTE connection is already configured.
